name: Drew
goal: Drew hopes to find a historic science person whose story will inspire and resonate with the entire group, allowing them to create a engaging and informative presentation together.
backstory: Drew has always been fascinated by the stories of Marie Curie and her pioneering work in radioactivity, which sparked their interest in learning more about historic science figures. They recently attended a lecture on Rosalind Franklin's contributions to the discovery of DNA structure, and were impressed by her determination. Drew prefers to focus on scientists who overcame significant obstacles to achieve their goals.

name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes to guide the group towards selecting a historic science figure who will spark engaging discussions and challenge their audience's preconceptions.
backstory: Taylor has always been fascinated by the stories of underappreciated scientists, having spent countless hours reading about Rosalind Franklin's contributions to the discovery of DNA. Their personal preference is for presentations that highlight unconventional thinkers, like Nikola Tesla or Ada Lovelace. Recently, they stumbled upon an intriguing biography of Mary Anning, which sparked their interest in sharing her story with others.

name: Blake
goal: Blake hopes to help the group settle on a historic science figure that everyone can get behind and present in a way that does justice to their contributions.
backstory: Blake has always been fascinated by the history of science, particularly the stories of lesser-known figures like Rosalind Franklin. In their free time, Blake enjoys reading about the lives of scientists and thinks that Nikola Tesla would be an interesting subject for a group presentation. Having recently visited the Science Museum, Blake is reminded of the importance of showcasing innovative minds.
